question: Should compute/mistral-la-plateforme meter its free tier on tokens rather than wall-clock, and does free_tier.metered_on need a tokens term?
why: the record sets free_tier.unit none and metered_on wall-clock, while the docs name requests per second, tokens per minute and tokens per month as the limits; inference/mistral-la-plateforme uses request-count, and metered_on has no tokens term
